scripts.dev: npm run build:embed && concurrently -n api,admin -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @support-hub/api" "npm run dev -w @support-hub/admin"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @support-hub/contracts && npm run build -w @support-hub/loader && npm run build -w @support-hub/widget && npm run build -w @support-hub/api && npm run build -w @support-hub/admin
scripts.check: npm run build -w @support-hub/contracts && npm run check --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @support-hub/contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.demo: npm run build && concurrently -k -n api,host "npm run start -w @support-hub/api" "npm run start -w @support-hub/demo-host"
scripts.build:embed: npm run build -w @support-hub/contracts && npm run build -w @support-hub/loader && npm run build -w @support-hub/widget
